purpose: Continue prospective immutable quote and post-quote public-trade evidence after legacy capture protocols reach their lifetime caps. New source version, not a strategy or order grant.
legacy_evidence: Never modify/delete/reset V1-V8 protocols, records, counters or caps. Do not import old rows as new prospective observations.
quote_source: Reuse successful maker DemoMarkets.quote reads only; no additional quote HTTP calls. Preserve metadata/book request and receipt clocks separately, rule projection and normalized depth20.
trade_source: Resume only the capped scan V4 read slot: at most one poll per60seconds, two pages of100records. Query30seconds strictly after a captured usable quote; wait until window ends, discard as unobserved if retrieval age exceeds120seconds. Oldest eligible window first; other unpolled/expired quotes remain visible. No added service, schedule or model calls.
priority: Poll only while account is flat with no working order, V4 is capped, and no maker/V15/timely markout is pending or due in next30seconds. Preserve source selection/skips; never force an entry.
archive: Separate SQLite file, append-only content-addressed gzip blobs for deduplicated metadata/book states, immutable receipt and public trade identities, durable poll intent before transport. Exact raw response pages retained. No owned fills inferred.
capacity_rule: At capacity or low disk, stop new evidence and report the exact condition; retain every earlier record. No automatic deletion, risk-limit increase or paid storage purchase.
